title: Human Development and Family Studies, B.S. — Human Development and Family Science Option (College of Health and Human Development)
notes: 2026-09-17 historical-year build for the 2024-2025 catalog edition. Fetched the real archived page (bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2024-2025/undergraduate/colleges/health-human-development/human-development-family-studies-bs/, raw curl + BeautifulSoup text extraction) and diffed it against both the 2025-2026 archive and the 2026-2027 live page. Finding: 2024-2025 is the FIRST catalog year with the current 'Human Development and Family Science Option' / 'Developmental Science for Health Professions Option' names and structure (the prior 2022-2024 editions used the older 'Life Span Human Services'/'Life Span Developmental Science' option names and a substantially different requirement structure -- see HDFS-2023.json's own notes for that changeover). Course-by-course, 2024-2025's option requirements are otherwise identical to 2025/2026: same prescribed HDFS 216/301/311/312W, same Additional Courses pools, same 18-credit option structure (Advanced Development, Advanced Family Topics, Professional Skills for HDFS Careers, Diversity and Development), same capstone pathway structure anchored on HDFS 490, same Gen Ed breakdown, same '120-123' Suggested Academic Plan total. Only program-description marketing prose differs (rewritten 'You Might Like This Program If...' bullets, etc.) -- not modeled here since it doesn't affect the flowchart. One real, verified quirk specific to this edition: the 2024-2025 Program Requirements course list for 'Advanced Family Topics' includes a bare 'HDFS 477' entry between HDFS 469U and SOC 430, with NO title and NO credit value in the bulletin's own HTML table cell (confirmed by inspecting the raw table row directly, not just the rendered text) and NO hyperlink to a course description (every other course in that list links to its description page). Cross-checked against the department's own 2024-2025 archived course-description page (bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2024-2025/university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/hdfs/) -- HDFS 477 does not appear there at all, and it is absent from this app's locally scraped hdfs_catalog.json. This looks like a stale/orphaned course-number entry left in that one edition's requirement table (removed again by 2025-2026), not a real schedulable course for that year -- excluded from this file's 'Advanced Family Topics Course' options list rather than adding an unfillable/unverifiable option, same tolerance this codebase already applies to other confirmed-but-uncheckable bulletin entries (e.g. 2026's CRIMJ 150N/RLST 137 in the Diversity and Development list, which at least resolve to real course numbers elsewhere -- HDFS 477 does not resolve anywhere). Campus: Brandywine confirmed Pattern A for this catalog year too (same 'Available at the following campuses' list, same curriculum, verified above); Erie/Behrend absent from this edition's campus list as well, consistent with every other year checked.
